Bring the cold plunge to you

Beit Sisu rents portable single-person ice baths for homes, events, gyms, teams and productions across Dubai and the surrounding areas.

Whether you want a week of daily plunges at home or a recovery station at your next event, we’ll set you up.

Contact us on WhatsApp for rates

How it works

  • We deliver, set up and collect. You just plunge.
  • Single-person portable ice bath, compact enough for a balcony, garden or gym floor.
  • With a chiller when there’s a power supply nearby, so the water stays cold all day.
  • No power? No problem. We can provide ice instead.
  • Indoor or outdoor: garden, balcony, rooftop, gym floor or event space.
  • Dubai and surrounding areas. Other emirates on request.

Perfect for

  • Home use: build a daily cold plunge habit without leaving the house.
  • Events and activations: wellness days, festivals, launches and pop-ups.
  • Corporate wellness: give your team a recovery station at the office or an offsite.
  • Gyms, studios and sports teams: post-training recovery for athletes and members.
  • Film, TV and photo shoots: a ready-to-use ice bath on set.

Why rent from Beit Sisu?

We run Dubai Media City’s private contrast therapy studio, so cold plunging is what we do every day. When you rent from us, you get the same know-how: advice on temperature, timing and how to plunge safely, from a team that uses ice baths daily.

Rates and availability

Our rates depend on the rental length, location and whether you need a chiller or ice. Message us on WhatsApp with your dates and location and we’ll send you a quote. Availability is limited, so get in touch early for events.

Contact us on WhatsApp for rates

Frequently asked questions

How cold does it get?

With the chiller connected, the water stays cold throughout your rental. Without power, we can supply ice to bring the temperature down. Message us and we’ll recommend the best option for your space.

Can it go outdoors?

Yes, the ice baths work indoors and outdoors.

Do you deliver and set it up?

Yes. We deliver the ice bath, set it up for you and collect it at the end of your rental.

Do you deliver outside Dubai?

We cover Dubai and the surrounding areas as standard. Other emirates are possible on request.

How many people can use it?

Each ice bath is designed for one person at a time. For events and teams, ask us about renting more than one.

Is cold plunging safe?

For most healthy adults, short plunges are safe. Start with 30 seconds to a minute, and check with your doctor first if you have a heart condition, high blood pressure, are pregnant or have any other medical condition. Read our beginner’s guide to ice baths.

How do I book?

Message us on WhatsApp with your dates, location and whether you have power available, and we’ll take it from there.

Prefer to plunge with us? Book a private cold plunge or contrast therapy suite at our Dubai Media City studio.

Partner with Beit Sisu

From team wellness days to community events, we love working with people who care about recovery as much as we do. Beit Sisu is a private contrast therapy studio inside the Arjaan by Rotana Hotel in Dubai Media City, with infrared saunas, cold plunges and red light therapy in fully private suites.

Ways we work together

  • Corporate wellness: recovery sessions for your team at our studio, or a wellness perk for your staff.
  • Clubs and communities: running clubs, golf societies, sports teams and social groups. We create a dedicated discount code for your members.
  • Events and activations: bring the cold plunge to you with our portable ice bath rental. Delivered, set up and collected, indoor or outdoor.
  • Brands and creators: product launches, content shoots and collaborations in a calm, private space.

Why Beit Sisu?

  • Completely private suites, so no shared rooms or crowds
  • Central location in Dubai Media City, minutes from Dubai Marina, JBR and Palm Jumeirah, with free valet parking
  • A team that does contrast therapy every day, and can guide first-timers

Get in touch

Tell us a little about your company or group and what you have in mind using the form below. Prefer to chat? Message us on WhatsApp.
